prompt: CSS display contents pseudo-elements box not generated
answer:
With `display: contents`, the element itself does not generate a box, but its children and pseudo-elements are normally still supposed to generate boxes. The element is treated as though it were replaced by its contents in the document tree. (W3C CSS Display, search result 2)

However, if `display: contents` applies to the pseudo-element itself, its box is not generated; its generated text can instead form a contiguous text sequence with surrounding content. (W3C test result, search result 8)
